briefdescription.para: For a given parameter set, compute the gyroaverage of a field which only depends on space (and on the batch dimensions).

parameterdescription.para: Field to process on input and its gyroaverage on output.
Parameter set whose coefficients will be used.

briefdescription.para: Operator to compute the gyroaverage of a field as a weighted sum of the its value at pre- determined sample points along the gyro-motion.

detaileddescription.para: Interpolation is used to evaluate the field at points which are not on the grid. The choice of treatment for points outside the domain (Dirichlet, constant outside, etc) is determined by the interpolation class itself.

We distinguish 3 types of dimensions:
"Params" refers to the dimensions which parametrise the gyroaverage of a given field; this usually corresponds to species and mu.
"InterpSpace" refers to the space dimensions along which the interpolation is performed, e.g. poloidal cross-sections when the approximation B // e_phi is assumed.
"BatchSpace" refers to the remaining dimensions, if any. The same coefficients are used for every batch index.

parameterdescription.para: The additional dimensions parametrising the gyroaverage (usually species and mu).
The batch dimensions on which the gyroaverage does not depend (default: none).
